title: Cluster-Guided Decoding with Trust-Region Constraints for Personalized Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2611.22163v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Most recommenders score each item in the catalog separately, and do not explicitly model which semantic region of the catalog a recommendation belongs to. Models expressive enough to offer that control are often too slow to run over a full catalog for online inference. In this paper, we present Cluster-Guided Generative Reconstruction (CG2R), which learns a hierarchy of semantic clusters and uses a cluster-level prior to steer item ranking for personalized recommendations. Unlike existing systems that only use clusters to pre-select candidates, CG2R adds the cluster prior directly to the item scoring rule, so that the learned cluster structure shapes the ranking itself. Because the prior is assembled from cluster centroids rather than per-item statistics, it remains defined even for cold-start users when no history is available. translated_title: 基于信任域约束的聚类引导解码个性化推荐方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.22163v1 公告类型：新论文。摘要：大多数推荐系统对目录中的每个商品单独打分，并未显式建模一条推荐属于目录中的哪个语义区域。而表达能力足够强、能够提供这种控制的模型，往往在全目录上进行在线推理时速度过慢。本文提出了聚类引导生成式重建（CG2R），该方法学习语义簇的层次结构，并使用簇级先验来引导个性化推荐中的商品排序。与现有仅将簇用于候选预筛选的系统不同，CG2R 将簇先验直接加入到商品打分规则中，使得学习到的簇结构能够直接塑造排序结果本身。由于该先验由簇质心而非逐商品统计量构成，即使对于没有任何历史记录的冷启动用户，先验依然有定义。在所评估的三个基准数据集上，CG2R 的表现优于经典方法、神经网络方法以及基于大语言模型的基线方法。
tldr: CG2R 通过学习语义簇层次结构并将簇级先验直接融入商品打分规则来塑造个性化推荐排序，且先验基于簇质心构建，因此对无历史记录的冷启动用户依然有效。
en_tdlr: CG2R learns a hierarchy of semantic clusters and injects a cluster-level prior directly into the item scoring rule to shape personalized ranking, remaining effective even for cold-start users since the prior is built from cluster centroids rather than per-item statistics.
